name: navigate_map
description: Move the persistent map camera to one authored view.

name: trigger_avatar_emote
description: Ask the avatar to play one approved semantic one-shot emote.

name: search_personal_memory
description: Privately search Yuyang's canonical memory. Use for every personal question not fully answered by authoritative base facts. Rewrite follow-ups as standalone queries and extract named entities.

query.description: Standalone query with pronouns and omitted references resolved.

entities.description: People, organizations, projects, places, dates, and aliases extracted from the question and conversation.

name: hyperlink
description: Look up an approved public URL before linking to one of Yuyang's profiles or affiliated organizations. Never invent or manually reconstruct these URLs.

key.description: Stable key for the approved link.

name: web_search
description: Search the live public web with Tavily when current, changing, niche, or externally verifiable information is needed. Do not use it for Yuyang's private personal facts.

query.description: A concise, standalone web search query with enough context to retrieve relevant results.
